title: macaranga hemsleyana
intro: Macaranga hemsleyana, commonly known as the "Kadapul tree," is a species of flowering plant in the family Euphorbiaceae. It is traditionally used in Southeast Asian medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating fever, cough, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Macaranga hemsleyana include its ability to reduce inflammation, kill bacteria, and protect against oxidative stress, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
